feeds.title: Troy Hunt
feeds.description: Troy Hunt is a cybersecurity expert known for creating Have I Been Pwned (HIBP), a service that allows users to check if their personal data has been exposed in a data breach. He regularly publishes research on breaches and their impact, aiming to raise awareness about privacy and security risks. Through his work, Hunt encourages better cybersecurity practices, such as using strong, unique passwords and enabling two-factor authentication.

feeds.title: Pkware Blog
feeds.description: PKWARE's blog focuses on topics related to data protection, encryption, and cybersecurity. It regularly features insights on preventing and managing data breaches, compliance strategies, and secure data management across different systems. The articles are written by the PKWARE team and industry experts, offering practical guidance and updates on recent cybersecurity incidents and trends.

feeds.title: Dark Reading
feeds.description: Cyber security's comprehensive news site is now an online community for security professionals, outlining cyber threats and the technologies for defending against them. DarkReading.com encompasses 10 communities, each of which drills deeper into the enterprise security challenge: Attacks & Breaches, Application Security, Cloud Security, Data Leaks & Insider Threats, Endpoint Security & Privacy, Mobile Security, Network & Perimeter Security, Risk Management & Compliance, Security Management & Analytics, and Vulnerabilities and Threats.

feeds.title: RedPacket Security » Data Breach
feeds.description: The RedPacket Security blog's data breach section shares news and updates about recent cyberattacks, leaked data, and security incidents. It provides brief reports on affected organizations and threat actors, focusing on timely breach information.

feeds.title: Daily Dark Web » Data Breaches
feeds.description: DailyDarkWeb is a community of volunteers dedicated to monitoring the unseen layers of the digital world. Our mission is to bring transparency to the dark web by sharing current news, cybersecurity incidents, and critical threat intelligence with the public in an open and responsible manner.

feeds.title: HIPAA Journal
feeds.description: The HIPAA Journal is the foremost independent authority and most trusted source of information on the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). The journal provides the healthcare sector's most comprehensive HIPAA news coverage of regulatory developments, enforcement actions, data breaches, and compliance best practices. Since its launch more than a decade ago, The HIPAA Journal has published over 7,000 articles and has built the largest readership of HIPAA compliance professionals.

feeds.title: Security Affairs » Data Breach
